messages.subject: Warning Notice - Maple Court Care Home (Regulation 12)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Pryce,

Please find issued to your portal a Warning Notice under section 29 of the Health and Social Care Act 2008 in respect of Regulation 12 (safe care and treatment) at Maple Court Care Home. The date by which compliance is required is 30 April 2025.

Regards,
Jane Hartley
Care Quality Commission

messages.subject: RE: Warning Notice - Maple Court Care Home (Regulation 12)
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Agreed. No appeal lies against a warning notice, and challenging an essentially accurate one would be counterproductive. We'll confine any comment to factual corrections and put all our energy into the remediation evidence for 30 April. Building the action-plan tracker with Lorna now.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
